title: Live: Israel launches broader attacks on Tehran as war goes into eighth day
summary: Israel carried out a wave of “broad-scale” strikes on targets in Tehran on Saturday, following Iranian missile launches towards Israel. Explosions were reported in Tel Aviv, but emergency services said there were no casualties, and residents were allowed to leave shelters. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: US President Donald Trump on Saturday said Iran would be "hit very hard", adding that he was considering expanding strikes to new targets, without providing details. Iran’s President Pezeshkian earlier announced that he would not “surrender” as demanded by Trump Friday and apologised to neighbouring countries for the strikes that targeted them. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
